SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.

REPORT

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
CENTRAL Q. D. 125
Date March 20, 1929

Subject (in full) Information laid by N. Shevchenko of the 2nd Company Russian
Unit, S.V.C.

Made by. D.I. Robertson. Forwarded by J.R. Owens A.C. Pol.

On March 13, 1929 information was received by
P.C.S. Makhluevsky from an informer to the effect that two
men named Toushlanikoff and Ivanoff, members of the 2nd
Company of the Russian Unit, S.V.C., stationed at Yangtszepoo
Camp, had returned from a day's leave to the barracks at 4 a/m.
on March 7. On entering their billet they were observed by
another soldier named N. Shevchenko, who had just been relieved
from sentry duty, to converse in undertones while Toushlanikoff
was seen to wipe blood stains from his clothing with a small
dirty Chinese towel, which he replaced in an open box that
serves as a locker by his bedside. Shevchenko, who gave the
information to the informer in the first instance, immediately
came to the conclusion that Toushlanikoff and Ivanoff were
responsible for the murder of Harcharan Singh and acting on
his own initiative awaited an opportunity to steal the small
Chinese towel, which Toushlanikoff had used, and handed it to
the informer who forwarded it to this office. The towel was
sent to the Municipal Laboratory on March 13 and from the
result of the analysis, which is attached herewith, was found
to contain human blood stains. On receipt of the original
information a watch was kept on Toushlanikoff and Ivanoff
and it was found that from March 13 to 19 they did not leave
the barracks except on duty. Shevchenko and the informer were
further questioned when the former stated that it was on the
morning of March 10 at 4 a/m/ the men had returned to their
barracks and not the morning of the 7th as previously stated
by him. It was obvious from his demeanour that he is an
irresponsible youthful individual with an imaginative turn of
mind.

报告

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事侦缉处登记室
中央巡捕房 D. 125
日期：1929年3月20日

主题（全称）：由俄国分队第二连 N. Shevchenko 提供的信息。

制作人：D.I. Robertson。转呈人：J.R. Owens，助理警司。

1929年3月13日，P.C.S. Makhluevsky 从一名线人处收到情报，称驻扎在杨树浦营房的俄国分队第二连的两名士兵 Toushlanikoff 和 Ivanoff 于3月7日凌晨4时结束一日休假返回营房。在进入他们的宿舍时，另一名刚下岗哨的士兵 N. Shevchenko 观察到他们低声交谈，同时看到 Toushlanikoff 用一条脏小的中国毛巾擦拭衣服上的血迹，随后将该毛巾放回床边作为储物柜使用的敞口箱中。Shevchenko 是最初向线人提供此信息的人，他立即断定 Toushlanikoff 和 Ivanoff 对 Harcharan Singh 谋杀案负责，并主动寻找机会偷走了 Toushlanikoff 使用过的那条小中国毛巾，将其交给线人，由线人转送至本局。该毛巾于3月13日送往工部局实验室，根据随附的分析结果，发现其中含有人类血迹。在收到原始情报后，对 Toushlanikoff 和 Ivanoff 进行了监视，发现从3月13日至19日，除执勤外，他们未离开营房。随后对 Shevchenko 和线人进行了进一步讯问，前者陈述说，这些人是在3月10日凌晨4时返回营房，而非他此前所说的7日凌晨。从其举止来看，他显然是一个不负责任、富有想象力的年轻人。

Inquiries were continued at the Yangtsepoo camp on
the afternoon of March 18 and 19 when it was ascertained that
Toushlanikoff and Ivanoff were on leave on March 9 and
returned to their barracks at 4 p.m. on the following morning.
Both men made verbal statements in the presence of Capt. Ivanoff,
camp Commandant, as to their movements while on leave and
these were verified and found to be correct.

The question of the ownership of the towel was then
inquired into and it was found that nearly every one of the
120 men in the camp possesses a towel similar to the one
found by Sherchenko, which is used for cleaning their rifles
and general dusting up. It was, therefore, impossible, to
fix the ownership on one individual as one man does not know his
towel from the other (except possibly by degree of filth.) It
is also possible that although the towel was found in
Toushlanikoff's locker it was put there by some one else as
the billets are inspected every Saturday when everything in
the nature of cleaning material is put out of sight. It is also
possible that it was left there by some of the 1st Company
of the Russian Unit that previously occupied the billets and
were transferred to the Amoy Road barracks on March 1.

Toushlanikoff's and Ivanoff's clothing which they
wore on March 9 were also carefully examined and no sign of
blood-stains was seen, nor did it appear that the clothes
were recently cleaned. It was also ascertained that
Toushlanikoff and Ivanoff occupy different huts and on
arriving at the camp on the morning of March 10 immediately
reported and went to their respective billets.

3月18日和19日下午，在杨树浦营房继续进行调查，查明 Toushlanikoff 和 Ivanoff 于3月9日休假，并于次日凌晨4时返回营房。两人在营房指挥官 Ivanoff 上尉面前就其休假期间的行踪作了口头陈述，经核实属实。

随后调查了毛巾的所有权问题，发现营房内120名士兵中几乎每人都拥有一条与 Shevchenko 发现的类似的毛巾，用于擦拭步枪和一般除尘。因此，无法确定所有权归属某一个人，因为一个人无法区分自己的毛巾和他人的毛巾（除非可能通过肮脏程度来区分）。也有可能虽然毛巾是在 Toushlanikoff 的储物柜中发现的，但是由他人放入的，因为每周六都会检查宿舍，届时所有清洁用品性质的物品都会被收起来。也有可能是之前占用该宿舍、并于3月1日调往爱多亚路（Avenue Edward VII，今延安东路）营房的俄国分队第一连的一些人留在那里的。

Toushlanikoff 和 Ivanoff 在3月9日穿着的衣服也经过了仔细检查，未发现血迹迹象，衣服似乎也未近期清洗过。还查明 Toushlanikoff 和 Ivanoff 住在不同的棚屋，并于3月10日上午到达营房后立即报到，各自前往宿舍。

In view of the result of these inquiries and of
the statement made by Sherchenko I can only suggest that
on the latter coming off sentry duty, seeing Toushlanikoff
and Ivanoff coming home and with his mind concentrated on
the Harcharan Singh murder, that what he reported was the
result of a dream, which was corroborated to a certain
extent by his finding the towel.
H. Robertson
D. I.

Shanghai Municipal Laboratory.

To The Commissioner of Police,

Material Reported on
Small hand towel received from Det. Insp.Robertson.

Received 15.3.29 Report No. 38484 Sent Out 16.3.29

Preliminary Examination.
The towel measures 20 "by 10". It is old and
worn and very dirty and oil stained. Dull brownish red
stains, with the appearance of blood stains, are visible
on the fabric towards the centre. This staining only
penetrates through the fabric in isolated spots.
Chemical and physical tests confirm the stain to
be blood stain.

Serological Examination.
Serological tests made with specific anti-human
blood serum on an extract of the stain and with the necessary
control tests showed that the stain was from human blood.

J G E Walker
F.I.C.
ANALYST.

Alice Polunin
CHIEF FORENSIC CHEMIST

上海工部局实验室。

致警务处长，

报告材料
从侦探督察 Robertson 处接收的小方巾。

接收日期：1929年3月15日 报告编号：38484 发出日期：1929年3月16日

初步检查。
该毛巾尺寸为20英寸乘10英寸。陈旧、磨损且非常肮脏，有油污。织物中心附近可见暗褐红色污渍，外观似血迹。这些污渍仅在个别斑点处渗透织物。
化学和物理测试证实该污渍为血迹。

血清学检查。
使用特异性抗人血血清对污渍提取物进行的血清学测试，以及必要的对照测试，显示该污渍来自人血。

J G E Walker
F.I.C.
分析师

Alice Polunin
首席法医化学师
